proposals.before: In the first month of spring in Tianshun one, at first light on renwu, Shi Heng, Marquis of Wuqing, Zhang Yue and Zhang Fu, regional commanders, Yang Shan, left censor-in-chief, Xu Youzhen, vice censor-in-chief, and the eunuch Cao Jixiang led troops to bring the Emperor out of the Southern Palace; he took the throne at Fengtian Gate and received the whole bureaucracy in audience.
proposals.after: In the first month of spring in Tianshun one, at first light on renwu, Shi Heng, Marquis of Wuqing, Zhang Ni and Zhang Yue, regional commanders, Yang Shan, left censor-in-chief, Xu Youzhen, vice censor-in-chief, and the eunuch Cao Jixiang led troops to bring the Emperor out of the Southern Palace; he took the throne at Fengtian Gate and received the whole bureaucracy in audience.
proposals.reason: 中文作「都督張輗、張軏」，張輗 is Zhang Ni and 張軏 is Zhang Yue; the English swaps the two men and invents the surname Fu.

proposals.before: In spring of the first year, first month, on the day renwu, at gray dawn, Marquis of Wuqing Shi Heng, Regional Commanders Zhang Yue and Zhang Fu, Left Censor-in-chief Yang Shan, Vice Censor-in-chief Xu Youzhen, and Eunuch Cao Jixiang with troops welcomed the Emperor from the Southern Palace, held court at Fengtian Gate, and the hundred officials attended.
proposals.after: In spring of the first year, first month, on the day renwu, at gray dawn, Marquis of Wuqing Shi Heng, Regional Commanders Zhang Ni and Zhang Yue, Left Censor-in-chief Yang Shan, Vice Censor-in-chief Xu Youzhen, and Eunuch Cao Jixiang with troops welcomed the Emperor from the Southern Palace, held court at Fengtian Gate, and the hundred officials attended.
proposals.reason: 中文作「都督張輗、張軏」，張輗 is Zhang Ni and 張軏 is Zhang Yue; the English swaps the two men and invents the surname Fu.

proposals.before: Rewards were fixed for the Gate-Seizing restoration: Shi Heng became Duke of Loyal States; Zhang Fu, Marquis of Taiping; Zhang Yue, Baron of Wen'an; Yang Shan, Baron of Xingji; and Cao Jixiang's adopted son Qin was made vice commissioner-in-chief.
proposals.after: Rewards were fixed for the Gate-Seizing restoration: Shi Heng became Duke of Loyal States; Zhang Yue, Marquis of Taiping; Zhang Ni, Baron of Wen'an; Yang Shan, Baron of Xingji; and Cao Jixiang's adopted son Qin was made vice commissioner-in-chief.
proposals.reason: 中文作「張軏太平侯，張輗文安伯」: 張軏 (Zhang Yue) received Taiping and 張輗 (Zhang Ni) received Wen’an; the English misnames both men.

proposals.before: Merit in the Gate-Seizing restoration was discussed and rewarded: Shi Heng was enfeoffed Duke of Loyal States; Zhang Fu, Marquis of Taiping; Zhang Yue, Baron of Wen'an; Yang Shan, Baron of Xingji; and Cao Jixiang's adopted son Qin was made Vice Commissioner-in-chief.
proposals.after: Merit in the Gate-Seizing restoration was discussed and rewarded: Shi Heng was enfeoffed Duke of Loyal States; Zhang Yue, Marquis of Taiping; Zhang Ni, Baron of Wen'an; Yang Shan, Baron of Xingji; and Cao Jixiang's adopted son Qin was made Vice Commissioner-in-chief.
proposals.reason: 中文作「張軏太平侯，張輗文安伯」: 張軏 (Zhang Yue) received Taiping and 張輗 (Zhang Ni) received Wen’an; the English misnames both men.

proposals.before: On jichou the court again ranked Gate-Seizing merit: Sun Zizong was made Baron of Huaining; Dong Xing, Baron of Haining; Tang Xu, director of astronomy, vice minister of rites on the right; and more than three thousand clerks, bannermen, and camp soldiers were advanced in rank.
proposals.after: On jichou the court again ranked Gate-Seizing merit: Sun Tang was made Baron of Huaining; Dong Xing, Baron of Haining; Tang Xu, director of astronomy, vice minister of rites on the right; and more than three thousand clerks, bannermen, and camp soldiers were advanced in rank.
proposals.reason: 中文作「封孫鏜懷寧伯」; the name is 孫鏜 (Sun Tang), the same man called Sun Tang later in the chapter, not "Sun Zizong".

proposals.before: On the day jichou, Gate-Seizing merit was again discussed: Sun Zizong was enfeoffed Baron of Huaining; Dong Xing, Baron of Haining; Director of the Directorate of Astronomy Tang Xu, Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of Rites; and banner troops, clerks, and garrison soldiers promoted in rank numbered more than three thousand in all.
proposals.after: On the day jichou, Gate-Seizing merit was again discussed: Sun Tang was enfeoffed Baron of Huaining; Dong Xing, Baron of Haining; Director of the Directorate of Astronomy Tang Xu, Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of Rites; and banner troops, clerks, and garrison soldiers promoted in rank numbered more than three thousand in all.
proposals.reason: 中文作「封孫鏜懷寧伯」; the name is 孫鏜 (Sun Tang), the same man called Sun Tang later in the chapter, not "Sun Zizong".

proposals.before: In the seventh month of autumn, on guimao, Shi Biao, Marquis of Dingyuan, was made general for the pacification of the Yi and supreme commander on the Ningxia front.
proposals.after: In the seventh month of autumn, on guimao, Shi Biao, Baron of Dingyuan, was made general for the pacification of the Yi and supreme commander on the Ningxia front.
proposals.reason: 中文作「定遠伯石彪」: 伯 is Baron, not Marquis. Shi Biao is only 進彪為侯 (promoted to marquis) later, in Tianshun 3.

proposals.before: In autumn, seventh month, on the day guimao, Marquis of Dingyuan Shi Biao was made General for the Pacification of the Yi and supreme commander to resist the enemy in Ningxia.
proposals.after: In autumn, seventh month, on the day guimao, Baron of Dingyuan Shi Biao was made General for the Pacification of the Yi and supreme commander to resist the enemy in Ningxia.
proposals.reason: 中文作「定遠伯石彪」: 伯 is Baron, not Marquis. Shi Biao is only 進彪為侯 (promoted to marquis) later, in Tianshun 3.

proposals.before: On jiachen Shi Biao, Marquis of Dingyuan, and Yang Xin, Marquis of Zhangwu, routed Bolai at Anbian Camp; Zhou Xian, commissioner-in-chief, and Li Jian, regional commander, were killed.
proposals.after: On jiachen Shi Biao, Baron of Dingyuan, and Yang Xin, Baron of Zhangwu, routed Bolai at Anbian Camp; Zhou Xian, commissioner-in-chief, and Li Jian, regional commander, were killed.
proposals.reason: 中文作「定遠伯石彪、彰武伯楊信」: both men hold 伯 (Baron), not 侯 (Marquis); Shi Biao is only advanced to marquis in the following sentence (進彪為侯).

proposals.before: On the day jiachen, Marquis of Dingyuan Shi Biao and Marquis of Zhangwu Yang Xin defeated Bolai at Anbian Camp; Commissioner-in-chief Zhou Xian and Regional Commander Li Jian died in battle.
proposals.after: On the day jiachen, Baron of Dingyuan Shi Biao and Baron of Zhangwu Yang Xin defeated Bolai at Anbian Camp; Commissioner-in-chief Zhou Xian and Regional Commander Li Jian died in battle.
proposals.reason: 中文作「定遠伯石彪、彰武伯楊信」: both men hold 伯 (Baron), not 侯 (Marquis); Shi Biao is only advanced to marquis in the following sentence (進彪為侯).

proposals.before: On renzi the Prince of Xiang, Zhu Zhanfan, came to court.
proposals.after: On renzi the Prince of Xiang, Zhu Zhanshan, came to court.
proposals.reason: 中文作「襄王瞻墡」; the prince’s given name is 瞻墡 (Zhanshan), so the English "Zhu Zhanfan" misreads the second character.

proposals.before: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengzi, the metropolitan camp eunuch Cao Xiangxiang and Cao Qin, Baron of Zhaowu, rose in revolt; Kou Shen, left censor-in-chief, and Wu Jin, Marquis of Gongshun, were killed; Sun Tang, Baron of Huaining, led troops and crushed the rebels.
proposals.after: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengzi, the metropolitan camp eunuch Cao Jixiang and Cao Qin, Baron of Zhaowu, rose in revolt; Kou Shen, left censor-in-chief, and Wu Jin, Marquis of Gongshun, were killed; Sun Tang, Baron of Huaining, led troops and crushed the rebels.
proposals.reason: 中文作「總督京營太監曹吉祥」; the eunuch is 曹吉祥 (Cao Jixiang), already named at the Gate-Seizing restoration, not "Cao Xiangxiang".

proposals.before: In autumn, seventh month, on the day gengzi, Cao Xiangxiang, eunuch superintendent of the metropolitan camp, and Cao Qin, Baron of Zhaowu, rebelled; Left Censor-in-Chief Kou Shen and Marquis of Gongshun Wu Jin were killed; Sun Tang, Baron of Huaining, led troops and put the rebellion down.
proposals.after: In autumn, seventh month, on the day gengzi, Cao Jixiang, eunuch superintendent of the metropolitan camp, and Cao Qin, Baron of Zhaowu, rebelled; Left Censor-in-Chief Kou Shen and Marquis of Gongshun Wu Jin were killed; Sun Tang, Baron of Huaining, led troops and put the rebellion down.

proposals.before: On guimao Xiangxiang was torn apart in the marketplace and his clan was wiped out; his followers, including Tang Xu, were all put to death.
proposals.after: On guimao Cao Jixiang was torn apart in the marketplace and his clan was wiped out; his followers, including Tang Xu, were all put to death.
proposals.reason: 中文作「磔吉祥於市」, an abbreviation of 曹吉祥; the English "Xiangxiang" repeats the misreading of his given name 吉祥 (Jixiang).

proposals.before: On jiayin Yang Lin, touring censor of Liaodong, was arrested for flogging officers without authority.

proposals.before: Grand ministers such as the Three Yangs, Hu Ying, and Zhang Fu were hereditary servants of several reigns, entrusted at the late emperor's death to guide the state, and public order had not yet slackened.
proposals.after: Grand ministers such as the Three Yangs, Hu Ying, and Zhang Fu were meritorious veterans of successive reigns, entrusted at the late emperor's death to guide the state, and public order had not yet slackened.
proposals.reason: 勳舊 means meritorious long-serving ministers, not household servants; 'hereditary servants' obscures the official standing named in the Chinese.
